ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty or early-termination fee, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a term.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, since Section 9 currently allows exit only for cause across a three-year term. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Add Section 9.4 giving Customer a 30-day termination-for-convenience right with pro-rata refund and confirming Vendor has no convenience right.
